description: Canonical unique sample identifier used across the project.
Participant/patient identifier for repeated-measure and subject-clustered analyses.
Preferred standardized categorical grouping field for custom comparisons.
Study cohort or recruitment stratum.
Primary diagnosis or disease label.
Optional disease subtype / phenotype subclassification.
Legacy 4C phenotype field retained for the built-in HYP comparisons.
Legacy 4C yes/no HYP field retained for the built-in HYP comparisons.
Longitudinal timepoint or visit label.
Collection date, preferably ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
Source material, e.g. PBMC, whole blood, tumor tissue.
Tissue/anatomical source when relevant.
Specimen preparation/type, e.g. cryopreserved PBMC, plasma.
Sex/gender field if appropriate for the scientific analysis.
Age at collection in years.
Family/household identifier when relatedness may matter.
Collection/recruitment site.
Study/project identifier for combined cohorts.
Collection wave/batch.
Sample-processing/extraction batch.
Library-preparation batch.
Sequencing/run batch.
Plate identifier.
Plate well.
Technical replicate identifier/number.
Alias used by gene-expression files/merged columns when different from sample_id.
Alias used by transcript-expression files/merged columns when different from sample_id.
Alias used by BCR files when different from sample_id.
Alias used by BCR-isotype files when different from sample_id.
Alias used by TCR-alpha files when different from sample_id.
Alias used by TCR-beta files when different from sample_id.
Alias used by immune-infiltrate files when different from sample_id.
Curator eligibility note (yes/no). It is not a substitute for frozen per-run QC review.
Curator flag for a known wrong tissue/source sample (yes/no).
Curator status such as include, review, or exclude.
Human-readable curator reason; run-specific automatic/manual QC remains frozen separately.
Free-text provenance or curation notes.
